name: music-downloader
description: An extensible, event-sourced music downloader and importer — a modular monolith.

scripts.build: tsc --noCheck -p packages/downloader/tsconfig.build.json && tsc --noCheck -p packages/importer/tsconfig.build.json && pnpm --dir packages/web run build
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/downloader/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/importer/tsconfig.json && pnpm --dir packages/web run check:svelte && pnpm run typecheck:tiers
scripts.typecheck:tiers: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p test/boundaries/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p test/e2e/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/downloader/scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/downloader/test/contract/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/importer/scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/importer/test/contract/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:contract: vitest run --config packages/downloader/test/contract/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config packages/importer/test/contract/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config packages/web/test/contract/vitest.config.ts
